script_hooks.logic:
Let container be the group of the enemy.
If condition flag v6 is up this frame, then increase the register's 'elapsedTurnByPoisonBog' by one.
If not (the enemy has the REGEN status), then the enemy gains the REGEN status.
Let v7 be run helper.
If v7 is not the register's 'currBpIdx', then
  Set the register's 'currBpIdx' to v7.
  Run helper2 and stop.
Otherwise, if the register's 'elapsedTurnByPoisonBog' is more than the numeric entry list at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'turnAiArg' in the battle settings of container, then
  Choose state 22 next.
  Set the register's 'elapsedTurnByPoisonBog' to 0 and stop.
Otherwise
  If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
  Stop.
